title: Incorrectly adding OPTIONS when disabled
detail: When PROVIDE_AUTOMATIC_OPTIONS is False, provide_automatic_options is set to False, but the code still adds "OPTIONS" to required_methods, causing OPTIONS routes to be registered even though they should be disabled.
note: Describes the planted negation: OPTIONS is added when automatic options are off.

title: Missing await on async read
detail: The `_read_some` method is asynchronous but is called without `await`, causing a coroutine object to be stored in `data` and leading to incorrect behavior or a runtime warning.

title: Potential IndexError when spans is empty
detail: When a variation selector is encountered and there is no previous character, the code enters the else branch where it accesses spans[-1] without checking if spans is non-empty. This can raise an IndexError for inputs that start with a variation selector or other zero-width characters.
